merge_decisions.justification: Same chemical concept: 'titanium dioxide (TiO2)' (paper B, s1) is the full name + abbreviation of 'TiO2' (paper A, p1). Concept-level merge only; the physical samples and device conditions differ between the papers and remain per-source in the node's evidence.
Identical task phrase 'perovskite solar cells' in p1 and s1; device instances are NOT merged, only the task concept.
'PCE' (s2) is the abbreviation defined in p2 as 'power conversion efficiency (PCE)'. Metric concept merge; the measured values stay as separate per-paper value nodes.

Identical generic method term 'spin-coating' in p1 and s3. Merged as a method concept with medium confidence because paper B gives no deposition parameters; this merge does NOT imply identical coating conditions.

conflicts.description: Both are performance numbers involving PCE, but they come from different papers, different devices and different conditions (AM 1.5G initial efficiency vs damp-heat retention). They must NOT be merged into one conclusion.
Paper A (citing Chen et al.) reports UV-driven degradation of TiO2 devices; paper B reports damp-heat-driven degradation. Different stressors; neither confirms nor contradicts the other.

uncertainties: Paper A reports no stability data; paper B's retention results must not be extrapolated to paper A's devices.
The degree sign in '85 C' (s1) was lost during text linearisation; verify against the publisher XML before reuse.
Chen et al. (p3) cannot be merged with any researcher outside this corpus: no affiliation or given name is reported.
